scope.execution: Sequential local Ollama inference through the fixed named-agent workflow runtime.
scope.network: Loopback Ollama only. No production services, external connectors, or LangSmith upload.
scope.comparisonCaution: The topologies perform different duties on tasks with different complexity. Results are not a fair model-quality comparison and do not establish optimization.
scope.grading: Only deterministic structural checks are automatic. Model prose and business correctness require human review.

complexity.description: One named sales agent prepares a small arithmetic-backed fictional quotation brief.

scenarios.objective: This is a fictional local benchmark for benchmark-basic-client. Prepare a concise quotation brief for 18 notebooks at 125 THB each plus a fixed 350 THB setup fee. Use the local calculate skill for the exact expression 18 * 125 + 350. State which figures came from this request and keep the result draft-only. Do not contact anyone or use any external service.

complexity.description: A sales agent prepares a document-grounded fictional quote and a QA agent independently reviews the handoff.

scenarios.objective: This is a fictional local benchmark for benchmark-pair-client. Prepare and verify a quote for 24 notebook covers at 85 THB each. The user-supplied local document identifier is DEMO-DOC-001. Use only the local read_document and calculate skills when they help your fixed step. Ground any lead-time statement in the document result, calculate 24 * 85, keep the quote draft-only, and pass reviewable evidence through the fixed handoff. Do not contact anyone or use any external service.

complexity.description: Five named departments build, constrain, persist, and review a fictional launch dossier through four sequential handoffs.

scenarios.objective: This is a fictional local benchmark for benchmark-advanced-client. Build a reviewable five-department launch dossier for Mango Works using the fixed role instructions and sequential handoffs. The user-supplied local document identifier is DEMO-DOC-001. The commercial quantity is 40 notebooks at 110 THB each plus a 600 THB setup fee; use the local calculate skill for 40 * 110 + 600 when relevant. Use local company or document evidence instead of inventing facts. The IT step must keep every capability local, client-scoped, and free of external connectors. The backend step may create exactly one title-only simulated task named Prepare fictional Mango Works launch dossier; repeated creation must remain idempotent. Quinn must review the recorded handoffs and tool evidence. Do not send messages, use production data, or access any external service.
